<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    水平条形图模板
    用途: 类别排名、数值对比（适合类别名称较长的场景）
    适用场景: 销售排行榜、品牌认知度、满意度评分
    支持: 8个条形（可调整为5-12个）
    与柱状图区别: 水平展示，更适合排名和类别名较长的数据
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 条形渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FFB74D;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="hbarShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="1" dy="0"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>品牌认知度排行榜</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年消费者调研报告 · 样本量 N=5,000</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- X轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="660" y1="140" x2="660" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="840" y1="140" x2="840" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1020" y1="140" x2="1020" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1200" y1="140" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- X轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="300" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>0%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="480" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="660" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>40%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="840" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>60%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1020" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>80%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1200" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>100%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Y轴基线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="620" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 条形数据 (条高36px, 间距24px, 总间距60px) -->
        
        <!-- 条形1: 品牌A - 92% (第1名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="175" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌A (市场领导者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="155" width="828" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1138" y="179" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>92%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形2: 品牌B - 78% (第2名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="235" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌B (新锐品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="215" width="702" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1012" y="239" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>78%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形3: 品牌C - 65% (第3名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="295" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌C (经典品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="275" width="585" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="895" y="299" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>65%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形4: 品牌D - 52% (第4名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌D (区域品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="335" width="468" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="778" y="359" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>52%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形5: 品牌E - 45% (第5名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="415" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌E (性价比品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="395" width="405" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="715" y="419" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>45%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形6: 品牌F - 38% (第6名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌F (高端品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="455" width="342" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="652" y="479" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>38%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形7: 品牌G - 25% (第7名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="535" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌G (新进入者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="515" width="225" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="535" y="539" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>25%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形8: 其他 - 12% (第8名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="595" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>其他品牌</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="575" width="108" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="418" y="599" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="60" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)"/>
        <text x="85" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高认知度 (≥50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="240" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)"/>
        <text x="265" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>中等认知度 (30-50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="450" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)"/>
        <text x="475" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif"

    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif"

</svg>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

[Pause] Welcome to the Artificial Analysis landscape review for April 2026.

Today we present an independent, data-driven comparison of 11 frontier AI models across three critical dimensions: intelligence, speed, and pricing. This analysis is designed to equip AI engineering leads and product managers with the factual basis for model selection decisions.

Key points: (1) Comprehensive coverage of 11 frontier models (2) Three-axis evaluation framework — intelligence, speed, cost (3) Independent benchmarking data from Artificial Analysis

Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_intelligence

[Transition] Let's begin with intelligence — the foundational capability metric.

The Intelligence Index from Artificial Analysis aggregates performance across reasoning, knowledge, and instruction-following benchmarks. As of April 2026, we see a two-way tie at the top: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and GPT-5.4 both score 57, neck-and-neck as co-leaders.

[Benchmark] Notice the 24-point spread from the top (57) to the bottom (33) of this ranking. This is not a trivial difference — it represents a substantial capability gap across the frontier landscape.

Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 sits at 53, four points behind the leaders. Meta's newly released Muse Spark enters at a strong 52, and notably, two open-weight models — GLM-5.1 at 51 and Grok 4.20 at 49 — occupy the mid-tier, demonstrating that the gap between proprietary and open-weight models continues to narrow.

Key points: (1) Two-way tie at 57 — no single leader (2) 24-point spread across 11 models (3) Open-weight models in top half: GLM-5.1 (51), Grok 4.20 (49)

Duration: 3 minutes

---

# 03_speed

[Transition] Building on intelligence, let's examine output speed — a critical factor for latency-sensitive applications.

The data reveals a striking inverse pattern. The fastest model, gpt-oss-120B, outputs 218 tokens per second — more than 4x faster than Claude Opus 4.6 at 49 tokens/s. [Data] This 218 versus 49 gap is nearly 4.5x.

[Benchmark] But notice: the two intelligence leaders — Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and GPT-5.4 — sit at positions 5 and 6 in the speed ranking, with 118 and 83 tokens/s respectively. Intelligence and throughput are inversely correlated at the frontier.

Five of the top ten speed performers are open-weight models. The engineering trade-off is clear: maximizing raw intelligence requires more compute, which reduces inference throughput.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- Background -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Top bar gradient -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#005587"/>
    <rect x="0" y="6" width="1280" height="74" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

    <!-- Page number -->
    <text x="1230" y="50" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A" text-anchor="end">06 / 06</text>

    <!-- Page title -->
    <text x="50" y="48" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        <tspan>Open Weights Close the Gap: Key Findings & Recommendations</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Takeaway box -->
    <rect x="50" y="90" width="1180" height="50" rx="4" fill="#005587"/>
    <text x="70" y="120" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="bold">
        <tspan>GLM-5.1 reaches 51 intelligence at $2.10/M tokens — within 10% of proprietary leaders at 1/5 the price.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Four key findings in 2x2 grid -->
    <!-- Finding 1 -->
    <rect x="50" y="160" width="560" height="130" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="70" y="190" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">
        <tspan>1. Two-way tie at the frontier</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="70" y="220" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and GPT-5.4 (xhigh)</tspan>
        <tspan x="70" dy="20">both score 57 on the Intelligence Index —</tspan>
        <tspan x="70" dy="20">no clear winner among the top two.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Finding 2 -->
    <rect x="650" y="160" width="580" height="130" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="670" y="190" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">
        <tspan>2. Speed vs. intelligence: inverse relationship</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="670" y="220" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>The fastest model (gpt-oss-120B at 218 tok/s)</tspan>
        <tspan x="670" dy="20">scores only 33 on intelligence. The two</tspan>
        <tspan x="670" dy="20">intelligence leaders operate at 83-118 tok/s.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Finding 3 -->
    <rect x="50" y="310" width="560" height="130" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="70" y="340" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">
        <tspan>3. 33x pricing spread</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="70" y="370" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>$0.30/1M tokens (gpt-oss-120B, DeepSeek V3.2)</tspan>
        <tspan x="70" dy="20">vs $10.00/1M tokens (Claude Opus 4.6).</tspan>
        <tspan x="70" dy="20">For budget-sensitive workloads, this matters.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Finding 4 -->
    <rect x="650" y="310" width="580" height="130" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="670" y="340" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">
        <tspan>4. Open-weight models are closing the gap</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="670" y="370" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>GLM-5.1 at 51 intelligence is within 10% of</tspan>
        <tspan x="670" dy="20">proprietary leaders, at $2.10/1M tokens —</tspan>
        <tspan x="670" dy="20">significantly cheaper than $5-10 range.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Actionable recommendations -->
    <rect x="50" y="460" width="1180" height="200" rx="6" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
    <text x="70" y="490" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        <tspan>Model Selection Guidance</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Three recommendation columns -->
    <rect x="70" y="520" width="350" height="110" rx="4" fill="#2E7D32" fill-opacity="0.15"/>
    <text x="90" y="548" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2E7D32">
        <tspan>Intelligence-Critical Tasks</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="90" y="575" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (57, $4.50)</tspan>
        <tspan x="90" dy="18">or GPT-5.4 (57, $5.60)</tspan>
        <tspan x="90" dy="22" font-weight="bold">Co-leaders on intelligence.</tspan>
    </text>

    <rect x="450" y="520" width="350" height="110" rx="4" fill="#0076A8" fill-opacity="0.15"/>
    <text x="470" y="548" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0076A8">
        <tspan>Speed-Critical Tasks</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="470" y="575" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>gpt-oss-120B (218 tok/s, $0.30)</tspan>
        <tspan x="470" dy="18">or Grok 4.20 (188 tok/s, $3.00)</tspan>
        <tspan x="470" dy="22" font-weight="bold">4x+ faster than premium tier.</tspan>
    </text>

    <rect x="830" y="520" width="350" height="110" rx="4" fill="#1565C0" fill-opacity="0.15"/>
    <text x="850" y="548" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1565C0">
        <tspan>Budget-Sensitive Tasks</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="850" y="575" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>DeepSeek V3.2 or gpt-oss-120B</tspan>
        <tspan x="850" dy="18">($0.30/M tokens, 42-46 intelligence)</tspan>
        <tspan x="850" dy="22" font-weight="bold">Lowest cost, decent capability.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Source -->
    <text x="50" y="695" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8899AA">
        <tspan>Source: Artificial Analysis, April 2026 | Data covers 11 frontier models across intelligence, speed, and pricing dimensions</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <text x="1230" y="695" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8899AA" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>CONFIDENTIAL</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>
